implementation_notes.velocity: native numeric units; no physical conversion or reference-derived calibration
implementation_notes.registration: quantized endpoint slots with actual in-support interpolation times retained
implementation_notes.epoch_clarification: 80 maximum per TCM and TAM stage; total 12-hour cap includes both and cache preparation. This explicitly clarifies the prior ambiguous 80-epoch reference limit; not an exact author schedule.
implementation_notes.joint_association: TCM and input embedding may adapt during TAM optimization with an explicit 0.1 completion auxiliary loss; not the original TCM/TAM/TFM joint objective
implementation_notes.seed_policy: seed20 evaluates both CE/contrastive for A0/A_full; seeds21/22 reuse the validation-selected branch of each role
